title: Equivalent Consumption Minimization Strategy
text: 用于 P0–P4 混合动力电动汽车的能量管理控制器，输入 7 路、输出 3 路；按 {Motor location} 指定电机位置；{ECMS method} 指定 ECMS 方法、{Differential gear ratio, N_diff} 指定差速器传动比、{Differential efficiency factor, eta_diff} 指定差速器效率因子、{Loaded wheel radius, Re} 指定负载车轮半径、{Transmission efficiency factors} 指定变速器效率因子 Gear, input torque, input speed、{Transmission gear number vector, G_trans} 指定变速器挡位编号向量、{Transmission gear ratio vector, N_trans} 指定变速器传动比向量、{Transmission efficiency vector, eta_trans} 指定变速器效率向量、{Transmission efficiency torque breakpoints, Trq_trans_bpts} 指定变速器效率转矩断点、{Transmission efficiency speed breakpoints, omega_trans_bpts} 指定变速器效率速度断点、{Transmission efficiency temperature breakpoints, Temp_trans_bpts} 指定变速器效率温度断点、{Transmission efficiency vector, eta_trans_tbl} 指定变速器效率向量 array、{Speed breakpoints, f_tbrake_n_bpt} 指定速度断点、{Commanded torque breakpoints, f_tbrake_t_bpt} 指定指令转矩断点、{Brake torque map, f_tbrake} 指定制动转矩映射表 array、{Minimum engine torque command table, f_tbrake_min} 指定最小发动机转矩指令表 vector、{Fuel flow map, f_fuel} 指定燃油流量映射表 array、{Minimum engine torque command, HEVEngTrq_min} 指定最小发动机转矩指令、{Fuel lower heating value, LHV} 指定燃料低热值、{Engine idle speed, N_idle} 指定发动机怠速转速、{Battery state-of-charge breakpoints, SOC_bpt} 指定电池荷电状态断点、{Battery charge limit table, ChrgLmt} 指定电池充电限值表、{Battery discharge limit table, DischrgLmt} 指定电池放电限值表、{Maximum battery current, BattCurrMax} 指定最大电池电流、{DC/DC converter efficiency, eta_dcdc} 指定 DC/DC 变换器效率、{Maximum battery charge power, BattChrgPwrMax} 指定最大电池充电功率、{Maximum battery discharge power, BattDischrgPwrMax} 指定最大电池放电功率、{Motor maximum torque table, f_tmtr_max} 指定电机最大转矩表 vector、{Motor speed breakpoints, f_mtr_w_bpt} 指定电机转速断点 vector、{Motor torque breakpoints, f_mtr_t_bpt} 指定电机转矩断点 vector、{Motor efficiency map, f_mtr_eta} 指定电机效率映射表 array、{Number of motor torque calculation points, Ngrid} 指定电机转矩计算点数、{P0 belt ratio, N_P0} 指定 P0 皮带传动比、{ECMS weighting factor, ECMS_s} 指定 ECMS 加权因子、{Penalty factor power, a} 指定惩罚因子幂、{Adaptive ECMS proportional gain, ECMS_Kp} 指定自适应 ECMS 比例增益、{Adaptive ECMS integral gain, ECMS_Ki} 指定自适应 ECMS 积分增益、{Constraint penalty factor, PenaltyFctr} 指定约束惩罚因子、{Target battery state-of-charge, SOCTrgt} 指定目标电池荷电状态、{Minimum battery state-of-charge, SOCmin} 指定最小电池荷电状态、{Maximum battery state-of-charge, SOCmax} 指定最大电池荷电状态，按实例取值。

params.name: Motor location
params.values: 电机位置 P0 (default) | P1 | P2 | P3 | P4

params.name: Transmission efficiency factors
params.values: 变速器效率因子 Gear, input torque, input speed, and temperature (default) | Gear only

params.name: Transmission gear number vector, G_trans
params.values: 变速器挡位编号向量 [0 1 2 3 4 5 6] (default) | vector

params.name: Transmission gear ratio vector, N_trans
params.values: 变速器传动比向量 [1 4.212 2.637 1.8 1.386 1 0.772] (default) | vector

params.name: Transmission efficiency torque breakpoints, Trq_trans_bpts
params.values: 变速器效率转矩断点 [25 50 75 100 150 200 250] (default) | vector

params.name: Transmission efficiency temperature breakpoints, Temp_trans_bpts
params.values: 变速器效率温度断点 [313 358] (default) | vector

params.name: Minimum engine torque command table, f_tbrake_min
params.values: 最小发动机转矩指令表 vector

params.name: Minimum engine torque command, HEVEngTrq_min
params.values: 最小发动机转矩指令 16.18610438796213 (default) | scalar

params.name: Maximum battery charge power, BattChrgPwrMax
params.values: 最大电池充电功率 -30000 (default) | scalar

params.name: Maximum battery discharge power, BattDischrgPwrMax
params.values: 最大电池放电功率 46000 (default) | scalar

params.name: Number of motor torque calculation points, Ngrid
params.values: 电机转矩计算点数 200 (default) | scalar

params.name: Adaptive ECMS proportional gain, ECMS_Kp
params.values: 自适应 ECMS 比例增益 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Adaptive ECMS integral gain, ECMS_Ki
params.values: 自适应 ECMS 积分增益 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Target battery state-of-charge, SOCTrgt
params.values: 目标电池荷电状态 60 (default) | scalar

params.name: Minimum battery state-of-charge, SOCmin
params.values: 最小电池荷电状态 40 (default) | scalar

params.name: Maximum battery state-of-charge, SOCmax
params.values: 最大电池荷电状态 80 (default) | scalar
